title: DEGEN.md
tagline: A human-curated list of official agentic integrations for web3
description:
A human-curated list of _official_ agentic integrations for web3. All MCP servers, CLI tools, SKILL.md files, /plugins, and llms.txt endpoints that help your agent navigate the Ethereum and EVM blockchain space.

I personally was not aware of all these tools existing until I saw them all in one place :)
how_its_made: The tech stack here simply serves the DEGEN.md file in the repository to the DO app hosted at https://degen.md. Every merge on main trigger a redeploy. The content of the file itself is manually curated, using a lot of human hours to crawl the web and confirm its technical correctness.
auto_summary: This project serves a manually curated markdown directory of Web3 agent integrations through a simple deployed web application.
